one_liner: Cloud-based customer service and support ticketing platform used by agents to manage tickets, help center content, chat, and voice.
access_note: A free 14-day trial (or a free trial/sponsored developer account) can be created without sales contact, giving immediate API and sandbox access.
api_breadth_note: Separate documented REST APIs cover Ticketing/Support, Help Center, AI Agents, Voice (Talk), Live Chat/Conversations, Sales CRM, Custom Objects, and Omnichannel/WFM.
existing_mcp_note: Zendesk runs a per-tenant official MCP server with OAuth and read/write scopes.

evidence.note: Confirms OAuth2 and API token auth, OAuth as recommended method.
Full catalog of Zendesk product APIs.

researcher_notes: Zendesk is actively deprecating plain API tokens in favor of OAuth (April 2027 cutoff).

one_liner: AI-first customer messaging and helpdesk platform combining a shared inbox, live chat, and the Fin AI agent.
access_note: 14-day free trial with no credit card required, plus free unlimited 'development workspaces' for building and testing integrations.
api_breadth_note: REST API covers conversations, contacts, companies, articles/help center, tickets, and Fin AI agent configuration.
existing_mcp_note: Official Intercom MCP integration, currently US-hosted workspaces only.

evidence.note: Documents access-token vs OAuth authentication model.
Official Intercom developer docs page for the MCP integration.

researcher_notes: Intercom retired its always-free Starter plan in 2023; paid seat-based tiers now start ~$29-39/seat/month.

one_liner: Cloud helpdesk and ticketing software for customer support teams, part of the Freshworks suite.
access_note: 14-day unrestricted free trial plus a genuinely free 'Sprout' plan (up to 3 agents) provide self-serve API keys with no sales contact.
api_breadth_note: REST v2 API covers tickets, contacts, companies, agents, and solutions/knowledge base.
existing_mcp_note: Freshworks has an official MCP integration for Freshdesk in Early Access/Beta (Enterprise plan); community MCP servers also exist.

evidence.note: Confirms HTTP Basic Auth using the API key as username.
Official Freshdesk developer API reference.

researcher_notes: The official Freshworks MCP server is gated to Enterprise-plan EAP participants.

one_liner: Shared inbox and customer communication hub that unifies email, chat, and social messages for teams.
access_note: 14-day free trial with full Professional-plan features and no credit card required; API tokens can be generated immediately within a trial account.
api_breadth_note: Core API covers conversations/messages, comments, tags, contacts, accounts, and organization/teammate management.
existing_mcp_note: Front runs an official hosted MCP server in open beta using OAuth 2.1 + PKCE.

evidence.note: Documents Bearer-token API tokens and OAuth2 as the two supported auth methods.
Official Front help article introducing the beta MCP server.

researcher_notes: Front recommends simple API tokens for single-company integrations, reserving OAuth for public multi-tenant apps.

one_liner: B2B customer support platform built around Slack-based and omnichannel support with AI assistants/agents for SaaS companies.
access_note: A free trial is offered, but paid plans have a 3-seat minimum at $59-70/seat/month, making sustained use effectively a paid-plan commitment.
api_breadth_note: Bearer-token REST API spans 22 documented resource groups (issues, accounts, contacts, teams, knowledge base, etc.).
existing_mcp_note: Pylon runs an official hosted MCP server with OAuth2, exposing issues, accounts, and contacts.

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer-token authentication, admin-only token creation.
Official Pylon page describing the hosted MCP server.

researcher_notes: Seat minimums mean a realistic minimum spend of ~$175-180/month even on Starter.

one_liner: Multi-channel help desk and live chat software combining ticketing, chat, call center, and social support.
access_note: 30-day free trial with no credit card required; API and integrations are included in every paid tier with no extra charge.
api_breadth_note: REST API v3 covers tickets, contacts/customers, agents, departments, and knowledge base articles.
existing_mcp_note: QualityUnit (LiveAgent's parent company) publishes an official liveagent-mcp-server on GitHub.

evidence.note: Confirms API key generation and header-based authentication.
QualityUnit GitHub repo for the official MCP server.

researcher_notes: LiveAgent's MCP server supports both a simple Bearer token and OAuth 2.1.

one_liner: AI-native B2B customer support platform unifying Slack, email, and in-app channels with an included AI agent (Ari).
access_note: 7-day free trial with no credit card required, and the entry Foundation plan ($35/seat/month) includes full API access.
api_breadth_note: Single GraphQL API covering threads/conversations, customer cards, machine users, and API key management.
existing_mcp_note: Official Plain MCP server, authenticated via the user's existing Plain account (no separate API key needed).

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer-token GraphQL authentication via machine-user API keys.
Official Plain help center article on the MCP server.

one_liner: Email-based shared inbox and helpdesk for customer support teams, with an integrated knowledge base (Docs).
access_note: 15-day free trial of the Standard/Plus plans requires no credit card; the free-forever plan (5 users) does not include API access.
api_breadth_note: Inbox/Mailbox API v2 (OAuth2) covers conversations, customers, mailboxes, tags, and workflows; separate Docs API for the knowledge base.
existing_mcp_note: Help Scout published its own first-party MCP server (read-only in its initial release).

evidence.note: Confirms OAuth2 authentication for the Mailbox API v2.
Official Help Scout announcement of its MCP server.

researcher_notes: The official MCP server is currently read-only by design.

one_liner: Ecommerce-focused customer service helpdesk and AI agent platform, mainly used by Shopify/BigCommerce/Magento brands.
access_note: Free 7-day trial (and a low-cost $10/month Starter tier) can be signed up for directly with no payment details required.
api_breadth_note: REST API covers tickets, customers, teams, and tags; a Postman collection is auto-provisioned per account.
existing_mcp_note: Gorgias publishes an official first-party MCP integration.

evidence.note: Confirms HTTP Basic Auth using account email + API key.
Official Gorgias docs page for connecting an AI assistant via the Gorgias MCP.

researcher_notes: Exact rate-limit-by-plan table is rendered via JS and not fully visible in a text fetch.

one_liner: Enterprise customer service platform organized around a single lifelong conversation timeline per customer, rather than per-ticket.
access_note: No public self-serve signup or trial is advertised; access is sales-led (demo/contact) with custom, typically annual-contract pricing, and API tokens require an admin-granted 'API User' permission.
api_breadth_note: Documented REST API and SDK covering conversations/customers/agents, with less publicly visible breadth detail than larger platforms.
existing_mcp_note: No official or community MCP server for Gladly was found.
main_blocker: Requires becoming a paying Gladly customer via a sales-led demo/contract (no self-serve signup) before any API token can be issued.

evidence.note: Confirms Basic Authentication and token-based auth model for custom integrations.
Official Gladly REST API reference/documentation home.

researcher_notes: Gladly is the clear outlier of the 10: no self-serve trial/signup, and no MCP server (official or community) as of this research.
